title: Python Thinking — Optional Reading Track
description: Reading and recall practice for Python concepts. This track does not execute Python code; use the C#, JavaScript, TypeScript, SQL, or React labs for runnable practice.
outcomes: Compare familiar JavaScript ideas with Python syntax
Predict Python truthiness and equality, including where they differ from JavaScript
Format output with f-strings, slicing, and explicit type conversion
Choose between lists, tuples, dicts, and sets and use their core operations
Replace map and filter chains with list, dict, and set comprehensions
Use default, keyword, *args, and **kwargs parameters and avoid the mutable-default trap
Loop idiomatically with enumerate and zip
Raise and handle specific exceptions with try, except, else, and finally
Model data with classes, properties, and dataclasses
Organize code into modules and guard script entry points with if __name__ == "__main__"
Isolate project dependencies with virtual environments and pip
Read and write files safely with with and pathlib
Build lazy sequences with iterators, generators, and yield
Count, group, and queue data with Counter, defaultdict, and deque
Write decorators and annotate code with type hints checked by mypy
Test Python code with pytest assertions, parametrize, and fixtures
Assemble a small command-line app from dataclasses, files, argparse, and tests
